# Elements generated by commuting elements commute

In any Kleene algebra, if $p$ is generated by $+$, $\cdot$, ${}^\ast$, $0$ and $1$ from a set of elements all of which commute with $q$, then $p$ commutes with $q$: $pq = qp$. In particular this holds in every [Kleene algebra with tests](kleene-algebras-with-tests.md).
